name: A Righteous Cause

angles.text: Garek Bandarion and Danitha's cohort mark a rare path: Forsaken rediscovering how to wield the Holy Light as paladins despite their undead state.
Leonid and Danitha seek a path back to the Light, though most Forsaken remain distant from or hostile to holiness in their unlife.
Leonid Barthalomew links the defenders of the Undercity with the Argent Dawn at Light's Hope Chapel in the Plaguelands.

faq.answer: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered is an undead member of the Argent Dawn. He works from Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands and keeps ties with former comrades in Lordaeron who fought beside him against the Scourge.
faq.q: Who is Leonid Barthalomew the Revered?

faq.answer: Danitha Morr is a Forsaken leader who fought beside Leonid Barthalomew during the Scourge attack on the Undercity. She leads a cohort that carries on Garek Bandarion's teachings and holy legacy.
Garek Bandarion was a Forsaken fighter who fell defending the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. Leonid believes he may have been the first Forsaken to wield the Holy Light again as a paladin.

When Naxxramas, a necropolis, attacked the Undercity, Forsaken champions including Danitha Morr, Leonid Barthalomew, and Garek Bandarion joined the city's defense against the Scourge. They suffered heavy losses.
faq.q: What happened during the attack on the Undercity?

faq.answer: Most Forsaken reject the Light, which brings excruciating pain to undead flesh. Garek Bandarion showed that an undead warrior can wield the Holy Light as a paladin. Danitha's cohort continues to study the practice.
faq.q: Can the Forsaken wield the Light as paladins?

faq.answer: After visiting his friends and speaking with Danitha Morr, Leonid plans to return to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. The Argent Dawn coordinates its fight against the Scourge there.
faq.q: Where does Leonid Barthalomew go after this?

sections.body: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered and Danitha Morr meet again after defending Lordaeron together. They survived Naxxramas's assault on the Undercity, though many comrades fell. Now they remember the dead and the hard road faced by Forsaken who still honor the Holy Light.
sections.title: Reunion of Veterans

sections.body: Leonid and Danitha remember Garek Bandarion, the fallen hero whose name was given to the keep. Leonid believes Garek may have been the first Forsaken to wield the Holy Light again as a true paladin. Most Forsaken have turned from the Light. Danitha and her cohort keep Garek's legacy alive and explore what holy unlife may allow.
sections.title: The Legacy of Garek Bandarion

sections.body: After speaking with Danitha, Leonid prepares to leave the keep and return to the fight against the Scourge in the ravaged east. He is stationed at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. There, he welcomes able-bodied adventurers ready to take up arms.
sections.title: Return to the Plaguelands

summary: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered and Danitha Morr meet again to remember the Undercity's defense against Naxxramas. They speak of Garek Bandarion, a fallen undead hero who found the Holy Light again as a paladin, and of the Forsaken who carry his path onward.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Righteous Cause
